# SkipOnce

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders its child on every page except the document's first.

The mirror of [`ShowOnce`](show-once.md), and the usual way to keep a running header off a cover page while letting it appear everywhere else.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new SkipOnce()
new SkipOnce(options: SkipOnceOptions)
new SkipOnce(child: IElement)
```
